dedupe_keys.name: csb reactive chemical incidents raw data us chemical safety board reactive hazard study

description: The incident table behind the US Chemical Safety Board's study of reactive chemical hazards. The downloadable Excel workbook, titled Reactive Chemical Incidents, has one sheet of about 190 rows with 23 columns per incident: date, location, company, chemicals, chemical classes and NFPA reactivity ratings, type of reaction, known or unknown chemistry, equipment involved, facility type, fatalities, injuries, property damage, type of consequences, public impact, reactive hazard, management system deficiencies, whether the chemicals are on the OSHA process safety management and EPA risk management plan lists, and data sources. The first row read dates from March 2001 and the file was last saved in July 2009. It is free to download from the CSB website; no licence is stated, and as a US federal work it carries no copyright notice in the file. Coverage is incidents in the United States. Caveats: a closed study set, not updated, and some fields are coded judgements from secondary sources. For simulation it gives frequencies and consequences of runaway reactions by equipment and facility type, to set failure rates for chemical plants in cascading accident models. A related catalogue record is the CSB investigations list.
